overview.description: The Bitwise Solana Staking ETF (BSOL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sol, short usd currency. The fund is a passively managed ETP that offers 100% direct exposure to Solana (SOL) while also seeking to earn additional SOL from staking rewards. BSOL was launched on Oct 28, 2025 and is issued by Bitwise.
